Senses.PreferredTarget: The precious seal shines in open space; layered brocade seams unfold
SearchAliases: the precious seal shines in open space; layered brocade seams unfold
Senses.Note: “The precious seal is wondrous in open space; layered brocade seams unfold” is an image of a seal and its intricate manifestation. Shiyu raises a seal yet warns against resting in the familiar line. Eryin voices it as a final answer in a sermon. Ying’an uses it to answer a monk’s request about the seal. Liaotang raises a document and speaks the line in a present entrustment. The image prompts an answer about what the seal does here.

Entries.SourceTerm: 寶殿無人空侍立，不種梧桐免鳳來

Senses.PreferredTarget: No one is in the precious hall, and the attendants stand in vain; without planting the phoenix tree, no phoenix comes
AlternateTargets: The treasured hall is empty despite its waiting attendants; no phoenix arrives where no tree is planted
SearchAliases: empty precious hall no phoenix tree Chan
attendants wait phoenix does not come Zen
Senses.Note: Attendants wait in a precious hall with no one present, and a phoenix cannot arrive where its tree has not been planted. Hongzhi gives the pair after an old question about the honored position. Yunxi, Huigong, and Wenmu reuse it in separate discussions of hidden authority and the relation of position to its expression. The hall and tree both point to an absent center rather than a person who can be displayed on demand.

Hanxiu Ruqian points his staff at the seat: the great jeweled lotus seat, held by the old sharpeners topsy-turvy, plunged them living into the unbroken hell — and now he, dragged by debts of office he cannot push off, joins the line tossing sand upon it, Guxue Zhenzhe lets his imagined one-track man complain that the jeweled lotus seat should carry some Chan, some Way, some mystery — not worldly patter like child's play — and answers him with the yellow-faced master's own rule that the world's talk and livelihood never opposed the true face, Jie'an Jin rules that every old sharpener on the jeweled lotus seat made clever into clumsy there, so today, unable to hold back, he files the case by the record, and Qiran Chaozhi has the great patron's birthday bring the mountain monk onto the jeweled lotus seat for the great buddha-work — settling everyone's doubting mind, lighting each one's hidden nature, opening the inherent power and the right-eye. Zhulang Chesheng is summoned by the grand guardian's feast onto the jeweled lotus seat to raise the one thing and repay the boundless debt, closing with the verse — without the heaven-shore unicorn colt, how would the fragrance flow for a hundred ages, Zhanran Yuancheng on Amitabha's birthday stages the buddha descending on his whisk-tip, seated on the vajra jeweled lotus seat, the crown-light shining on worlds beyond count, Chuiwan Guangzhen, in his bridge-repair inscription, sets the road-leveling sage who won the prediction entering the jeweled lotus seat — a sage of perfect penetration whose merit passes reckoning — and Xiuye Minglin is asked how, before he has even mounted the jeweled lotus seat, the sweet dew already moistens all beings, answering that the eyes of gods and men are opened wide and the old face forgotten.
